data.description: You send out a burst of luck with a 30-foot radius centered  around you. While the beacon of luck is in effect, you gain  a +2 sacred bonus on all saving throws. As an immediate  action before a saving throw is made, allies within the area  can choose to benefit from this luck, rolling twice for a saving  throw and taking the better result. Once a creature benefits  from the beacon of luck in this way, it cannot gain the benefit  of this spell for 24 hours.
